headline: Approved Preschool Family Handbook, $60,000 FairShare grant for O'Maley Science Center, and other FY27 grants totaling over $1.8 million
summary: The School Committee approved the consent agenda, including a $400 donation for the Robert Natti Story Corner. The committee approved the Preschool Family Handbook with minor changes, and accepted several grants including a $60,000 MA FairShare Earmark Grant and federal IDEA and Title grants totaling over $1.8 million. The Superintendent gave an update on the opening of school.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the $400 donation from Susanne Natti for the Robert Natti Story Corner.
Approved the Preschool Handbook with minor changes made by the committee.
Approved the O'Maley Middle School Science Center FY 27 FC2518 MA FairShare Earmark Grant of $60,000.
Approved FY27 federal grants including IDEA Part B ($998,031), IDEA Part C ($28,774), Title I Part A ($639,855), Title II Part A ($89,250), Title III Part A ($45,674), and Title IV Part A ($49,235).

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: To approve the consent agenda as noted above.

VOTED: To approve the O'Maley Middle School Science Center FY 27 FC2518 MA FairShare Earmark Grant of $60,000.
VOTED: To approve the above grants as noted.

This meeting was conducted with the School Committee in person 
and the public participating in person and remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson Clancy called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. and
stated the mission of the Gloucester Public Schools.
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend meetings in person.
Alternatively, the public may attend through the Zoom link provided on the agenda.  The
meeting notice will reflect if the meeting is via Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to
the Open Meeting Law allow, the School Committee may continue to hold meetings
remotely.  Please note the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if
technological problems interrupt the remote connection.  If you are calling in on a phone,
you can press Star 9 (*9) to request to speak.  If you are watching on a computer or
device, there is a “raise hand” button that you can tap or press to request to speak.  Please
use either of these options during Oral Communications to be recognized to speak.
